Unique opportunity in the historic heart of Leiria!

We present Prédio do Arco, a landmark palatial property located in one of the most prestigious and central areas of the city. With an approved project, this development foresees the requalification of existing buildings and the creation of 18 modern apartments, prioritizing family typologies.

The project contemplates the harmonization between architectural preservation and modernization, including:

 Maintenance of dominant uses - housing, commerce and services/offices

 Requalification of the building, with demolition of annexes and areas in ruins

 New construction, guaranteeing greater efficiency and comfort

 Reorganization of access to the plot, optimizing functionality

Located in a flat and central area, this building promises to be a valuable asset for those seeking a solid investment in a rapidly appreciating real estate market.
